observed: The settings window's preview drew no contour. Cause measured in the browser: `phone-sw.js` is registered at scope `/` and its fetch fallback answered every failed GET — module scripts included — with `/phone.html`, so `/settings-window.js`, `/settings-engine.js`, `/contour.js` and `/ui-audit.js` came back as 200 text/html, the module loader refused them by MIME type, the engine never ran and the contour was never drawn. A page without the contour is the visual signature of a refused package, and it was being produced by a service-worker fallback, not by the signer.
correction: The fallback now answers a navigation with the shell and answers any other request with the cached asset itself or a network error: a cached script or sheet is still served offline (the phone's offline guarantee is unchanged), but a script is never replaced by an HTML page. Nothing was removed from the phone's posture — no scope change, no cache bypass, no relaxed origin check, no token or signature path touched. `popit-sw.js` carries the same rule.
refused: The earlier draft of this fix returned early for every non-navigation request, which would have removed the cached-asset fallback the phone relies on offline; that draft was replaced before it was kept, because narrowing the phone's offline behaviour to make a preview work is exactly the trade the owner refused ("Do not lower the shell's security to satisfy a weaker implementation, the popit-shell's phone security is a family rule").
measured: Browser reads of the settings window after unregistering the stale worker: documentElement dataset.package=verified, identity `app-settings@40+blake3:86d0d10… · theme popit-settings@275`, 30 contour paths drawn, 47 contour surfaces. tools/gate.py 63 checks, 1 refusal (freshness-no-stale-rows: the four ui audits and the dialin rebuild, each a driver act). ui/settings-window.js reads /api/toast/apps/settings before loadContour, so a refused package now says so by name instead of showing a blank surface (gate leg window-contour-implies-a-verified-package).
